newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - July 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - July 14.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on July 14. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The Bank Artha Graha group has received the approval from the finance ministry to acquire Bank Arta Prima as part of the ongoing consolidation of the troubled Indonesian banking sector.
South African President Nelson Mandela arrived on the holiday island of Bali on Sunday as part of a four-day official visit aimed at improving bilateral economic ties.
National Land Agency chief Sonny Harsono said the government had temporarily frozen the issuing of licences to develop islands or coastal land until a new decree was issued.
Agriculture Minister Syarifuddin Baharsyah said the government had withdrawn import duty on fish caught in Indonesia's exclusive economic zone.
